summary: timestamp_nanos_opt incorrectly returns None for representable timestamps near i64::MIN because multiplying whole seconds by one billion underflows before adding the positive subsecond component. The fix shifts negative fractional timestamps one second toward zero and subtracts one billion from the subsecond component before checked arithmetic. The upstream test added by this commit exercises the i64::MIN roundtrip. This is a proposed verbatim reversal; no builds or tests were run.
